name: financeiro
description: Gerenciador financeiro pessoal — API (Fastify + Drizzle + PostgreSQL) e web (React + Vite).

scripts.setup: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install && node scripts/setup-env.mjs
scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix api run db:migrate && npm --prefix api run db:seed
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix web run build
